content.short: Lara Protocol is the native decentralized liquid staking solution on Taraxa.
content.description: Lara Protocol is a Solidity-based staking and delegation protocol that lets users stake tokens, delegate them to validators, and automatically claim rewards. It delivers a streamlined, one-click staking flow with no KYC, and includes an optional auto-compounding feature that users can enable or disable at any time. By keeping TARA tokens liquid, the protocol enables using these assets across a broad range of DeFi applications, expanding liquidity and yield opportunities.
